subject: MILITARY ACTIVITIES WITHOUT FIRING WILL TAKE PLACE WITHIN ATHINAI
text:
A4070/26 NOTAMN
Q) LGGG/QWELW/IV/BO /W /000/100/3829N02331E005
A) LGGG B) 2611101600 C) 2611102200
E) MILITARY ACTIVITIES WITHOUT FIRING WILL TAKE PLACE WITHIN ATHINAI
FIR AS DESCRIBED BELOW:
1.- EXERCISE AREA (WITHOUT FIRING): CIRCLE 5NM RADIUS CENTRED ON
382923N 0233058E.
AWYS B1 AND M749 (SIGFO-ROPOX), TANAGRA MTMA/MCTR AFFECTED.
2.- PROCEDURES FOR EXERCISE AIRCRAFT:
2.1.- EXERCISE AIRCRAFT WILL FLY VFR/VMC IN ACCORDANCE WITH ICAO
RULES AND PROCEDURES AS AMPLIFIED IN AIP-GREECE.
2.2.- EXERCISE AIRCRAFT WILL SUBMIT FLIGHT PLANS AND WILL NOT ENTER
CONTROLLED AIRSPACE, UNLESS PRIOR PERMISSION HAS BEEN OBTAINED BY
APPROPRIATE ATC UNIT.
3.- PROCEDURES FOR NON EXERCISE AIRCRAFT:
3.1.- IN THE INTEREST OF SAFETY DURING THE EXERCISE, NON EXERCISE
AIRCRAFT ARE STRONGLY ADVISED NOT TO FLY WITHIN THE AREA
DESIGNATED IN PARA (1) ABOVE.
3.2.- AIRCRAFT UNABLE TO AVOID THE EXERCISE AREA WILL BE AUTHORIZED 
TO ENTER THIS AREA AFTER SPECIAL PERMISSION BY APPROPRIATE
ATC UNIT.
F) SFC G) 10000FT AMSL
